popup.args: Format 1.0 (feature 011): parameter name -> string value; must match the params of the target popup exactly (missing, extra, wrong kind: E_POPUP_ARGS). Also on events.click of SVG elements (binding files).

params.description: Format 1.0 (feature 011, contracts/project-format-1.0.md §3, §5): where a {param} may appear in a template item or in an item of a popup with params. Plain string substitution, no expression, no nesting; any other '{' or '}' is E_TEMPLATE_PARAM.

kinds.string: UTF-8 without control characters, at most 128 bytes
kinds.number: a finite JSON number written as a string

places.note: a tag slot value (or an element of a multi slot): {p} alone or {p}.SUFFIX
a string property, or a string element of an array property of strings
the whole value is {p}; substituted as a number
a string value of the args of a popup action inside a template, replaced when an instance is expanded
